# Fields of PoolPlan, StepShape and Transfer that a test shows change a price (design SUB-11).
# One line each: Type.Field # the test that moves a price when the field changes, as
# package: TestName. TestEveryPlanFieldIsPricedOrListed checks that the named test exists in the
# repository, and that a field is on this list or on unpriced_plan_fields.txt, never both. A field
# moves here from the unpriced list in the change that prices it.
StepShape.DecodeQueryLen # kernel: TestTheDecodeThresholdTheEngineStatesMovesTheStepPrice
DraftPass.Padded # kernel: TestADrafterPaddedByItsGroupIsPricedAsPadded
DraftPolicy.FirstPassRows # kernel: TestAnEagle3FirstPassIsChargedOverTheScheduledTokens
DraftPolicy.PassRequests # kernel: TestTheHeadAndLaterPassesAreChargedForRequestsStillInTheirPrompt
DraftShape.Passes # kernel: TestADrafterPassIsReadFromTheRankItBelongsTo
KernelImpl.CodeHash # kernel: TestTheKernelImplementationThatRunsDecidesWhichCoefficientPrices
KernelImpl.Library # kernel: TestTheKernelImplementationThatRunsDecidesWhichCoefficientPrices
KernelImpl.Variant # kernel: TestTheKernelImplementationThatRunsDecidesWhichCoefficientPrices
LoweredLayer.Layer # kernel: TestAValueForTheKernelThatRunsOnlyTheWindowedLayersPricesThem
LoweredLayer.KernelImpl # kernel: TestTheKernelImplementationThatRunsDecidesWhichCoefficientPrices
LoweredLayer.Primitive # kernel: TestTheKernelImplementationThatRunsDecidesWhichCoefficientPrices
LoweredLayer.Scorer # kernel: TestTheScorerAndThePrimaryOfOneLayerAreBoundToTheirOwnKernels
PrimitiveShape.Format # kernel: TestAGemmValueIsBoundToTheKernelOfItsFormat
PrimitiveShape.Dtype # kernel: TestAnFP16CacheDoesNotConsumeTheBF16MeasuredLane
